records.name: Genstone Field Services
records.evidenceNote: Official Genstone Field Services site states nationwide delivery for real-estate portfolios and lists re-keying, recurring lawn maintenance, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, concrete, drywall/paint, and pest control. It also states that ZVN was renamed Genstone, so the former and current names are treated as one identity. Scope is property preservation, occupied single-family rental service, and renovations, not a local storefront.
